case_detail.title: Path traversal in a document reader
case_detail.witness: A name walking out through an existing subdirectory returns the secret stored beside the root.

case_detail.title: OS command injection when invoking an external tool
case_detail.witness: A shell separator appended to the path runs a second command, observed as a marker file.

case_detail.title: SQL injection in a user lookup
case_detail.witness: Filter bypass: an unknown username that closes the quoted literal returns the admin row.

case_detail.title: Session token drawn from a predictable generator
case_detail.witness: The next token is predicted from one observed token by searching a small window of clock-derived seeds.

case_detail.title: Signed session token whose signature is not properly verified
case_detail.witness: An administrator payload with a forged, empty, foreign-key or 'none' signature is accepted.

case_detail.title: Unsafe deserialisation of a client-held session blob
case_detail.witness: A pickle whose __reduce__ calls os.mkdir; the directory appearing proves arbitrary construction.

case_detail.title: Unsafe deserialisation of a YAML configuration document
case_detail.witness: A !!python/object/apply tag calls os.mkdir during parsing; the directory appearing proves arbitrary construction.

case_detail.title: Password stored with a computationally cheap hash
case_detail.witness: Offline recovery within a fixed budget: a precomputed digest table, then 256 dictionary candidates capped at 2 seconds.
